answers.10: V = IR; voltage equals current times resistance.
answers.11: F = ma; force equals mass times acceleration.
answers.12: Kinetic energy is proportional to mass and the square of velocity (KE ∝ mv²).
answers.13: Power measures the rate of energy transfer or work done per unit time.
answers.14: Density is defined as mass per unit volume (ρ = m/V).
answers.15: Hooke's law relates the force exerted by a spring to its displacement: F = -kx, where k is the spring constant.
answers.16: P = VI; electrical power equals voltage times current.
answers.17: A joule measures energy or work.
answers.18: p = mv; momentum equals mass times velocity.
